title: Parent
description: A mod where you go through layers of dimensions to fight your father
body:
uhhh this mod was made in modrinth pls dont hurt me

# CONTEXT
You locked ur dad inside minecraft by making a deal with lock, but your dad is messing with the world around you, so now you have to defeat your dad and lock to free your world (neither of them have been added yet this is still an early alpha)

# PROGRESSION
theres some spoilers here but i suggest seeing it anyways cuz ur prolly not gonna understand anything cuz ur too stupid and im too idiot
## EARLY GAME
start by setting up a wheat and sugar farm, these will be helpful in the mid game, go to the caves, get as many gems as you can (all of them are the same tier), while your at it, get 3 diamonds along with alot of coal, iron, redstone and if you can lapis, a few gold as well will help, now you can make either a generator or a solar panel to power 2 machines, the drill which costs 3 diamonds and i recommend getting it as fast as possible as it will allow you to generate ores out of thin air, and the refinary, the last one is able to get you to mid game

## MID GAME
now, first, you will use ur sugar and wheat to make some good mod buff items, there 3 tiers currently and the last tier will not have any side effects (debuffs), now, use ur refinary with some gem blocks and some electronic coal to make a refined gem, you can combine this with diamonds from ur drill(s) to make OP gear, finally, combine all the types of gems to create an amalgamation of souls, batch craft a few of these they will be useful, aside from being decent early game ranged weapons with low damage and high knockback, you can craft 2 items with these, first its gilgamesh the amalgammer (its an axe not a hammer btw), and the totem of the amalgamation being a spawn item, now before you spawn Luis The Amalgamation of Souls i recommend full gem gear, some good foods, tier 3 buffs and gilgamesh, everything enchanted but it doesn't need to be the best gear, once u right click with the totem luis will spawn and he explodes every few seconds and will spawn some vexes when at half heatlh, but shouldn't be much of a struggle, once defeated you will gain a broken interdimensional key and a Tier 1 dimensional gate, you can repair the key with gem blocks and amalgamations of souls, once your ready, right click the key in the gate and you will enter end game and the barcanacks

## END GAME
Now, you have entered the first layer of this mod, the barcanacks, this is a place time wanted to leave behind, a time before the dinossaurs, a time of suffering, the first thing you should do is kill some stegoressaurus for their spikes but careful, the are not easy to deal with, after that, mine some fossils, combine a few fossils to make ultra condensed fossils, once you get enough spikes and condensed fossils make fossil armor, the Gore Claw and if possible, the best pick of the rest of the mod, the Bone Pick, after that try to find the Goreganotossaurus lair and fight him, you will gain alot of ultracondensed fossils and spikes but also some rad essence, i haven't updated the mod to have more stuff yet but i got alot of plans, also i lied, THIS WILL STILL BE EARLY GAME, HAHA LOSER
